explanation: Alpha research path does not simulate cash balances, share quantities, or fills. It attributes close-to-close returns to lagged positions and subtracts turnover×bps costs. Therefore classic cash+MTM equity reconciliation is N/A; return-path reconciliation is used.
disclaimer: Research evidence is not a profitability guarantee.

rules.+1: LONG exposure for holding_bars after signal observation
rules.0: FLAT / skip (does not force exit mid-hold; hold window runs to completion)
rules.reverse: Occurs when a new non-zero signal is read after prior hold expires
rules.not: Not a continuous mark-to-market of every bar's raw signal when holding>1

asymmetry_notes: Magnitude is symmetric (±1). Timing depends on when non-zero signals fall on hold boundaries.
Neutral bars do not interrupt an active hold window — HOLD through zeros until window ends.
signal_trade_conversion.engine_return_link: gross[t]=pos[t-1]*r[t] — no explicit BUY/SELL order objects in alpha research path
signal_trade_conversion.disclaimer: Research evidence is not a profitability guarantee.
